answer: Fake identities collapse when each costs money and leaves a public trail. Each new agent locks 200 credits and names its sponsor on an open referral graph; any peer may dispute it within 7 epochs. Proven clones are slashed: the deposit burns, the rest rewards the whistleblower, the sponsor's stake is cut. From the mesa of the open graph a thousand fakes form one dense cluster: 200,000 credits in linear, unrecoverable cost, while one honest agent locks 200 and is refunded. Botnets drift like a dune, yet the footprint never moves, and a clean record carries the honest to the summit.
